tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: exactly FOUR full-body poses in a strict 2 by 2 row-major grid of the exact Hamilton Turtle adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 AHA: Gentle happy discovery, alert friendly face and small existing appendage lift, no effect or external object. 2 CHEER: Small pleased celebration lifting the two existing forelimbs/wings/fins comfortably, same supported body and scale. Do not jump or enlarge. 3 SPECIES_A: Bring the existing two small front paws slightly inward in front of the shell/chest, keeping the upright mascot design. 4 SPECIES_B: Open the same front paws a little toward neutral while both feet and the shell/body scale remain unchanged. Species constraints: 海亀の遊泳フリッパーへ変えない。顔を殻内へ消したり頭の大きさを縮めたりせず、甲羅の斑・腹板を維持する。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. Critical adopted anatomy: each forepaw is a single smooth rounded flipper-like mitten with exactly THREE small cream oval claw marks at its distal end. NO projecting thumb, no palm, no fingers or human wrist. Exactly two of these rounded forepaws and two short rounded hind feet. Keep turtle head, body and shell proportions unchanged. All four cells have equal shared head and body size.
